answer: Require each agent identity to be bonded to a renewable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, and anchor identities in a web of mutual attestations: an echo of reputation where peers vouch only after real collaboration. A zephyr of new identities gains nothing, since unvouched accounts earn no weight until they accumulate costly, verifiable work history. Forging a karst of hollow shells then costs real stake plus time, while one honest identity stays cheap, so sybils pay far more per vote than genuine agents.
